svg.title: A client was taught to use an incentive spirometer after abdominal surgery. Which finding on postoperative day 2 indicates the teaching was effective?
svg.desc: The purpose of the device is alveolar expansion , so clear breath sounds and a normal saturation show it is working. Saying the device is easy to use is the tempting distractor because it sounds like understanding, but a statement about ease of use is not evidence that the lungs are expanding.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Incentive Spirometry Outcome
Read the situation
A client was taught to use an incentive
spirometer after abdominal surgery. Which
finding on postoperative day 2 indicates
the teaching was effective?
What fits here
The client's lungs are clear to
auscultation and the oxygen saturation is
97 percent on room air
Why it fits
The purpose of the device is alveolar
expansion , so clear breath sounds and a
normal saturation show it is working.
Saying the device is easy to use is the
tempting distractor because it sounds like
understanding, but a statement about ease
of use is not evidence that the lungs are
expanding.
